about: RAG source material. Downloaded by `python -m edge_grader.rag.sources` into data/rag/raw/ (git-ignored). Books: sha256 pinned after the first download; a mismatch means the file changed upstream. Wikipedia: topics per SciEntsBank (FOSS) unit, English from Simple English Wikipedia (English Wikipedia if missing), Indonesian from the interlanguage link; `pinned` records the revision fetched.
